name: Longboard
description: A woman in her mid seventies, a lifelong surfer who sings sixties garage-surf rock, unhurried and cooler than everyone on the beach.
build: A lean, wiry adult build with strong shoulders, a straight back, sinewy arms and long legs of ordinary proportion, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Deeply tanned weathered bronze skin with fine laugh lines, pale grey-green eyes under straight silver brows, a narrow nose, high cheekbones and thin lips.
hair: Thick silver-white hair in one long heavy braid falling over the character-right shoulder to mid-chest, full and wavy at the crown.
outfit: A vintage long-sleeved spring-suit wetsuit in deep teal neoprene with one wide bold mustard-yellow band across the chest and down each sleeve, legs cut at mid-thigh, sleeves ending at the wrists with both hands fully bare; a chunky round black dive watch on the character-left wrist; bare feet. Her head is bare.
performance_style: Relaxed and loose: feet wide apart as if on a board, knees soft, weight settled low on the back foot. Both arms hang easy, the character-right and character-left hands open and empty beside the thighs, fingers visible. Head tilted slightly, a knowing half-smile.
location: An early-morning surf beach: wet packed sand running to the bottom of the frame, rolling blue-green waves breaking behind, a rack of old wooden longboards against a dune fence, and a pale gold sunrise sky.
recognition_cues: a deep teal wetsuit with a wide mustard-yellow band
avoid: a surfboard held in the key art

sing.intent: Garage-surf vocal loop: she brings the mic in the character-right hand to her mouth, rocks her hips and knees low as if riding a wave, the character-left hand trailing out at hip height, then returns to the relaxed stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief startle at a loud beach sound: the shoulders jump, the torso draws back and both open hands rise to chest height, then she settles back into the opening stance. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: step the feet a little wider, bring the character-left forearm across the chest with the character-right hand open at the hip, and hold a steady grounded finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: she paddles-walks in barefoot with a loose rolling gait, flicks the braid back over the shoulder and settles into the relaxed stance.
